definitions.gloss: an invention; an invented device or product
definitions.explanation: A new device, machine, or product that someone has invented; the concrete result of an act of invention.

examples.japanese: すばらしい{発明品|はつめいひん}だ。
⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧エジソン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{発明品|はつめいひん}だ。
examples.english: The light bulb is Edison's famous invention.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}{会|かい}→展示会：21869_tenjikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦ユニーク→ユニーク：11393_yuniiku⟧な{発明品|はつめいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Unique inventions thought up by students are on display at this exhibition.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧ (invention) + the suffix ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (article, product). Refers to a concrete invented object, as opposed to the abstract act of inventing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{発明品|はつめいひん}: a new invention
- ⟦{画期的|かっきてき}→画期的：06826_kakkiteki⟧な{発明品|はつめいひん}: a groundbreaking invention
- {発明品|はつめいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exhibit an invention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧: invention — the act or process of inventing, or the idea itself; {発明品|はつめいひん} is specifically the physical product
